verses.text: The people of Jerusalem made Ahaziah, Jehoram's youngest son, king after him. The raiders who came with the Arabs into the camp had killed all the older sons. So Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah became king.
Ahaziah was forty-two years old when he became king, and he ruled for one year in Jerusalem. His mother was Athaliah, the granddaughter of Omri.
He also followed the ways of Ahab's family, because his mother gave him advice to do evil.
He did evil in the LORD's eyes, as Ahab's family had done. After his father died, they became his advisers, and that led to his ruin.
He followed their advice and went with Joram son of Ahab king of Israel to fight against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead. The Syrians wounded Joram.

Joram went back to Jezreel to heal from the wounds he got at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to Jezreel to visit Joram son of Ahab, because he was hurt.
God used this visit to Joram to bring about Ahaziah's downfall. When Ahaziah got there, he went out with Joram to meet Jehu son of Nimshi, the man the LORD had anointed to wipe out Ahab's family.
While Jehu was punishing Ahab's family, he found the leaders of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah's relatives who were serving Ahaziah, and he killed them.

Then he went looking for Ahaziah. Jehu's men caught him hiding in Samaria. They brought him to Jehu and killed him. They buried him, because they said, "He was the grandson of Jehoshaphat, who looked to the LORD with all his heart." No one in Ahaziah's family was strong enough to rule the kingdom.
When Ahaziah's mother Athaliah saw that her son was dead, she set out to kill the whole royal family of Judah.

But Jehoshabeath, King Jehoram's daughter, secretly took Joash son of Ahaziah away from the king's sons who were about to be killed. She hid him and his nurse in a bedroom. Jehoshabeath, daughter of King Jehoram and wife of Jehoiada the priest, was Ahaziah's sister. She hid the boy from Athaliah, so Athaliah did not kill him.
He stayed hidden with them in God's temple for six years, while Athaliah ruled the land.
